name: DS248x 1-Wire Bus Master
description: The `ds248x` component supports DS2482-100, DS2482-101, DS2482-800, and DS2484 I2C-to-1-Wire bridge chips. Configure the bridge itself under `ds248x`, then create one or more [1-Wire bus](https://esphome.io/components/one_wire/) entries using the `ds248x` platform.
